In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

in the non- obese diabetic mouse there is a low but sustained expression of inducible nitrogen oxide synthase in islets in the prediabetes phase, which is followed, in the peri-diabetic period, by a significant up-regulation of the enzyme in macrophages and a few beta-cells.

inducible nitrite oxide synthase is expressed in beta-cells and macrophages in non-obese diabetic pancreata, and that this expression is enhanced in islets of mice exposed to interleukine-1 beta alone or together with tumor necrosis factor-alpha and/or interferon-gamma.

inducible nitrite oxide synthase is present in beta cells and macrophages of the non-obesse diabetic mouse, and that its expression is up-regulated in beta cells and/or macrophages in response to interleukin-1β alone or in combination with tumournecrosis factor- α and/or interferon-gamma.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of inducible NOS in islets of non-obese diabetic animals is a feature of the prediabetic phase and is not related to the cytokine treatment.
in the non- obese diabetic mouse, inducible nitriic oxide synthase is expressed within beta- cells and macrophages in the prediabetes period.

the enzyme expression in the islets of the diabetic mice is low and sustained, which increases around the onset of diabetes.
